{
  "candidate_rtl": "`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #
(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)
(
    input  wire [WIDTH-1:0]         input_unencoded,
    output wire                     output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0]         output_unencoded
);

parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

generate
    if (WIDTH == 256 && LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY == 0 && LEVELS == 8 && W == 256) begin : fast_256
        wire [15:0] group_valid;
        wire [15:0] group_enable;
        wire [15:0] group_winner;
        wire [15:0] low_terms [3:0];
        wire [15:0] high_terms [3:0];

        for (genvar g = 0; g < 16; g = g + 1) begin : groups
            wire [15:0] local_input;
            wire [15:0] local_winner;
            wire [3:0] local_encoded;

            assign local_input = input_unencoded[g*16 +: 16];
            assign group_valid[g] = |local_input;

            if (g == 15) begin : top_group
                assign group_enable[g] = 1'b1;
            end else begin : lower_group
                assign group_enable[g] = ~(|group_valid[15:g+1]);
            end
            assign group_winner[g] = group_valid[g] & group_enable[g];

            for (genvar j = 0; j < 16; j = j + 1) begin : local_bits
                if (j == 15) begin : top_bit
                    assign local_winner[j] = local_input[j];
                end else if (g == 0 && j == 0) begin : default_bit
                    assign local_winner[j] = ~(|local_input[15:1]);
                end else begin : lower_bit
                    assign local_winner[j] = local_input[j] & ~(|local_input[15:j+1]);
                end
                assign output_unencoded[g*16+j] = local_winner[j] & group_enable[g];
            end

            assign local_encoded[0] = |(local_winner & 16'haaaa);
            assign local_encoded[1] = |(local_winner & 16'hcccc);
            assign local_encoded[2] = |(local_winner & 16'hf0f0);
            assign local_encoded[3] = |(local_winner & 16'hff00);

            for (genvar b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : encode_terms
                assign low_terms[b][g] = local_encoded[b] & group_enable[g];
                if ((g & (1 << b)) != 0) begin : included
                    assign high_terms[b][g] = group_winner[g];
                end else begin : excluded
                    assign high_terms[b][g] = 1'b0;
                end
            end
        end

        assign output_valid = |group_valid;
        for (genvar b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : encoded_outputs
            assign output_encoded[b] = |low_terms[b];
            assign output_encoded[b+4] = |high_terms[b];
        end
    end else begin : general_implementation
        wire [W-1:0] input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid [LEVELS-1:0];
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc [LEVELS-1:0];

        for (genvar n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : loop_in
            assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
            end else begin : msb
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
            end
        end

        for (genvar l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : loop_levels
            for (genvar n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : loop_compress
                assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
                if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] = stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ? {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} : {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
                end else begin : msb
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] = stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ? {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} : {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
                end
            end
        end

        assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
    end
endgenerate

endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The previous candidate propagates encoded values through seven dependent priority-multiplexer levels and routes one-hot results through a similarly deep selection tree. Late upper-subtree valid signals control these paths.",
  "rewrite": "Use sixteen parallel 16-bit local priority detectors and parallel suffix reductions over sixteen group-valid signals. Generate one-hot outputs directly from local winners and higher-group exclusion, without encoding and decoding. Form encoded outputs with masked OR reductions. Group enables deliberately exclude their own group-valid signal, removing an unnecessary dependency from one-hot and low encoded outputs.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to reduce maximum data arrival by replacing serial mux propagation with shallow reduction, exclusion, and AND/OR paths. The critical paths should move to group exclusion and final encoded reductions. No numerical timing improvement or electrical-violation result is claimed without running the specified mapping and STA flow.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Parallel local and group suffix reductions trade some logic duplication for reduced depth. Shared group-valid reductions and elimination of the encoded-to-one-hot decoder should help contain area. Compliance with the 8862.124480um2 cap and zero slew/capacitance violations requires mapped-flow verification.",
  "functional_boundaries": "For the assessed instance, the highest asserted input index wins for every binary input pattern. With all inputs zero, output_valid is zero, output_encoded is zero, and output_unencoded is 256'b1, matching the original ungated decoder. Module ports and parameter declarations/defaults are preserved. Other parameter settings use the original algorithm. The design is entirely combinational and uses no assumptions, storage, or undefined outputs."
}
